run_benchmark_latency: run the latency benchmark subcommand to measure single-batch request processing latency
add_cli_args_latency: add CLI arguments for the latency benchmark including batch size, input length, and output length
run_latency_with_beam_search: run the latency benchmark with beam search enabled for multiple generated sequences per prompt
run_latency_with_profile: run the latency benchmark with profiling enabled to capture torch or cuda profiler results
run_latency_save_json: run the latency benchmark and save results to a JSON file with average latency and percentiles
